narrative.overview: Atmosphere over flat fill: soft accent glows and grain over solid black. Glass, not cards-for-cards’ sake. Dark by default — cream Satoshi UI on near-black, with Instrument Serif reserved for studio heroes. Brand and product marks lead; headlines support, never overpower. The Instagram bio page is a shell-off exception of the same world: token inheritance, no studio nav, unlinked from product chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Real product imagery — wordmarks and icons, not stock collages
Dark by default; cream text on near-black
Accent is a CSS variable, never a hard-coded gold

rules.name: The Marks-Lead Rule
rules.body: Brand and product marks lead; headlines support, never overpower.

rules.name: The Accent Variable Rule
rules.body: Do not hard-code gold into new components — use var(--accent). Accent drives CTAs, doc links, soft glows, and atmospheric radials.

rules.name: The Glass-When-It-Earns-It Rule
rules.body: Use .glass when a surface holds interaction or a distinct content block — not for every paragraph.

rules.name: The Unlinked Bio Rule
rules.body: expenses/get/ inherits tokens from css/styles.css and must not appear in studio or product navigation.

dos: Do use CSS variables from css/styles.css — no one-off hex for accent, text, or background.
Do keep store CTAs as .btn.btn-primary then .btn.btn-secondary, opening in a new tab.
Do treat expenses/get/ as a studio-shell exception: Satoshi + styles.css + get.css only.
Do keep store-linked paths intact (privacy, support, delete-account, invite).
donts: Don’t add expenses/get/ to studio or product nav.
Don’t drop the bio landing into the nav-hero-resources template.
Don’t invent a parallel palette on a leaf page.
Don’t hard-code gold; don’t load a theme picker on the bio page.
Don’t stuff stats, schedules, promo chips, or secondary marketing into a first viewport.
